import os,re
def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    y0=min(y for y,x in tilecells); x0=min(x for y,x in tilecells)
    tile=[[gi[y][x] for x in range(x0,max(x for y,x in tilecells)+1)] for y in range(y0,max(y for y,x in tilecells)+1)]
    th,tw=len(tile),len(tile[0])
    print('==',k,'bg',bgv,'mark color',mc,'marks',marks)
    print('tile at',(y0,x0),'dims',(th,tw))
    for row in tile: print(''.join(str(x) for x in row))
    for mm in marks:
        hits=[]

                if sc==th*tw: hits.append((dr,dc))
        print('  ',mm,hits)

from collections import Counter
def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; best=None
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if gi[i][j]!=bgv and not seen[i][j]:
                stack=[(i,j)]; cs=set()
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in cs: continue
                    cs.add((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in cs and gi[ny][nx]==gi[y][x]:
                                stack.append((ny,nx))
                if best is None or len(cs)>len(best): best=cs
    ys=[y for y,_ in best]; xs=[x for _,x in best]
    y0=min(ys); x0=min(xs); th=max(ys)-y0+1; tw=max(xs)-x0+1
    T=[[gi[y][x] for x in range(x0,x0+tw)] for y in range(y0,y0+th)]
    H,W=len(T),len(T[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    marks=sorted({(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]!=bgv and (i,j) not in best})
    # find anchor by maximizing full-stamp coverage among markers
    cands=[]
    for dh in range(H):
        for dw in range(W):
            n=sum(1 for mm in marks
                  if 0<=mm[0]-dh<H and 0<=mm[1]-dw<W
                  and all(0<=mm[0]-dh+a<h and 0<=mm[1]-dw+b<w for a in range(H) for b in range(W)))
            cands.append((n,dh,dw))
    cands.sort(reverse=True)
    print('anchor candidates:',[(c[:2],k) for k,(c,_) in enumerate(cands[:6])])
    n_,ah,aw=cands[0]
    for mm in marks:
        tl=(mm[0]-ah, mm[1]-aw)
        for a in range(H):
            for b in range(W):
                p,q=tl[0]+a,tl[1]+b
                if 0<=p<h and 0<=q<w: out[p][q]=T[a][b]
    return out,(n_,ah,aw),marks,H,W

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    pred,info,Ts=solve(gi)

    print(k,'anchor',info[:3],'mismatch',len(mism),mism[:6])

# The two previous submissions were identical grids yet both judged wrong. Something else differs.
# Compare my computed test output vs alternatives: check what my f does on the test input concretely
import os,re
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
gi=G['Test input']
h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
seen=set(); comps=[]
for i in range(h):
    for j in range(w):
        if gi[i][j]!=bgv and (i,j) not in seen:
            stack=[(i,j)]; cs=set()
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                if (y,x) in cs: continue
                cs.add((y,x))
                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in cs and gi[ny][nx]!=bgv:
                            stack.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(cs)
big=max(comps,key=len)
ys=[y for y,_ in big]; xs=[x for _,x in big]
print('bg',bgv,'blob size',len(big),'bbox',(min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs)))
marks=sorted({(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]!=bgv and (i,j) not in big})
print('markers',marks,[(gi[m[0]][m[1]],) for m in marks])
